params.name: Input
params.description: The node whose geometry the first pass of the loop reads, through the input node inside.

params.name: Iterations
params.description: How many times the chain inside runs, each pass reading the last one's result. 0 passes the input through; at most 1000.

params.name: Stop When Unchanged
params.description: Ends the loop early at a pass that changes nothing, since every later pass would find the same.
